description.narrative: In March 2020, tripartite partners agreed to launch a renewed national dialogue to revise and implement the Social Security Law, whose implementation was suspended in January 2019. Dialogue participants are reviewing amendments to the law, on the basis of technical and actuarial reviews of proposed changes and recommendations to ensure fiscal alignment and adherence to international labour and social security standards. Later in 2021, the legal drafting committee will revise the text of the draft law and submit it for approval by the Steering Committee and eventual endorsement and enactment by the President's Office in 2022. With support from RBSA, the ILO has facilitated the resumption of discussions among tripartite partners on the draft Social Security Law. By September 2021, three meetings of the Technical Committee formed in March 2021 had been held. The ILO delivered actuarial assessments on proposed amendments to the law discussed during those meetings. The ILO also solicited expertise for a capacity-building programme and proposals for a communications strategy to assist social partners in deliberations and managing information about the on-going dialogue.

description.narrative: The Palestinian Pension Agency (PPA) Board of Directors endorsed, in February 2020, the periodic actuarial valuation of the social insurance schemes for civil servants and security personnel administered by the PPA. On the basis of recommendations regarding needed reforms to ensure fiscal alignment, the PPA established a working committee and nominated members, including from President/Prime Minister's Office as well as representatives of scheme contributors, to deliberate on the findings and forge a path forward for reform. In February 2020, the ILO completed a periodic actuarial valuation and presented its findings to the PPA Board of Directors. Signalling the need for parametric changes to the scheme to preserve fiscal alignment, the ILO recommended the creation of a committee to deliberate on possible reform options, which was ultimately taken up by PPA management.
